mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) FROM audio_author_usage WHERE audio_id = #{audioId}

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.published_count), 0) FROM author_content_stat s WHERE s.author_id = #{authorId} AND s.type = #{type.code} AND s.visibility = #{visibility.code}) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.reference_count), 0) FROM audio_author_usage u LEFT JOIN audio a ON a.id = u.audio_id WHERE u.author_id = #{authorId} AND u.reference_count > 0 AND (a.id IS NULL OR a.review_status = #{banned}) AND u.type = #{type.code} AND u.visibility = #{visibility.code})
